name.description:
If provided, then this instance will be treated as a reference and a {@link Config} lookup
will be performed at the beginning of any function call.
If not provided, then this instance will be treated as "in memory" and the fields will
be used as-is for any function call.

issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

description.description: Optional description for intended usage of this client instance.

model.description: A reference to the model(s) that this client should use.

router.description:
Routing logic that implements load balancing between {@link #models} (and auth), if
multiple are provided.

title:
Base interface for types that implement a client for a particular LLM task.
The client essentially joins one or more models to a {@link #router}.
For example, see {@link GenaiCore.Llm.Completion.Client}.
Since there can be multiple clients per task, this type is {@link Named}.
The default client instance shall be named "default", so in order to configure a
default instance, be sure to create a configuration with that name.

See {@link GenaiCore.Llm.Completion.Client}, as an example of a type implementing this interface.
name: GenaiCore.Llm.Client
